answer: State-level research includes all direct and indirect costs of EEI or member company responses to state inquiries, proposed rulemaking or proceedings, including filing comments. Federal-level research also includes agency discussions, background studies and analysis, responses to inquiries about potential impacts or implementation, and monitoring existing federal programs.
